rationale: The visible evidence supports the core resource-gate portion: MODEL_AVAILABILITY reports model_family_gate_met=false with status=resource_gated_family_gate_failed and six resource-gated model ids; the oral-ready gate evidence says status closed with no venue-readiness, downstream utility, or pretrained-reference superiority claims; and the producer report identifies resource-gated family expansion as a next priority.
